profiles.description: Official ComfyUI workflow templates created by the Comfy team.
AI creator exploring new tools, workflows, and creative possibilities. Passionate about open-source projects, I share tutorials, experiments, and demos on YouTube and Bilibili.

VFX Supervisor, Nuke Compositor, Creative Technologist, and VFX Instructor specializing in AI-driven workflows for visual effects. With over 18 years of experience across Feature Film, Animation, Theme Parks, Commercials, and Immersive media.

He focuses on bridging traditional VFX pipelines with emerging AI tools, developing practical, production-ready workflows and training for professional artists. Through his teaching, tools, and consulting work, Doug helps studios and individuals integrate AI into their pipelines while maintaining creative control and high-end visual quality.

For the latest work and updates, visit www.doughogan.com.
I am a videographer and content creator who also enjoys messing around with VFX and AI. I build AI-Driven Video Solutions with workflows and new tools.

I'm a Creative Technologist that started using ComfyUI as a hobbyist looking for a creative outlet. I love testing new models, digging into different nodes, training loras, and stitching workflows together for both creative and marketing driven use cases. I'm drawn to the experimental side of things and sharing what I learn. I always come back to making workflows that are clean and easy to follow (no spaghetti).
Ingi is an Emmy-nominated creative entrepreneur. CEO and co-founder of Systms. Previously: Founder @ Golden Wolf (acquired by Doodles in 2023)
Creating Comfy workflows for Video Editors, Motion Designers and Content Creators.

Founding member of ComfyUI.
I build workflows with the creative team.
I work with agents 24/7.
Building an agentic ComfyUI experience, ComfyHub, and API model integrations.

I am Julien Durand, an AI Artist and Digital Creator based in Los Angeles and one of the In-House Creatives at ComfyUI. I use ComfyUI as the core of my creative process, building custom workflows to generate and enhance images and videos. With a background in mechanical engineering, I approach generative art with a systems mindset, experimenting with nodes, pipelines and automation to push visual quality and creative possibilities. I enjoy exploring new techniques, optimizing workflows and sharing what I learn with the ComfyUI community.
Hello, I’m a creative video maker and tech enthusiast who loves exploring the endless possibilities of AI-generated content.

I’m Ohneis, also known as Ohneis652. I share practical insights on visual AI, with a strong focus on branding and design.

A big part of what I do is helping people use AI to work faster and run their businesses more effectively. I also post a lot of tutorials, along with updates on new developments in AI.

Creative & Live Stream Host • Comfy.org
AI & Motion Graphics Educator • Creative Exploration wtih Purz
8 Years Daily Animation • 2900+ Consecutive Days
International Exhibitions • Toronto Based

Shane is a digital artist and creative director based in New York. He explores the synergy between AI and 3D animation to produce a diverse array of digital works. He has collaborated with clients such as Porsche, Burberry, and the Academy Awards. His work has been featured on It's Nice That, Designboom, and Hypebeast.
Sirolim is a Creative Technologist building templates for ComfyUI. When he's not working on templates or movies, he loves agentic engineering.
